goal: Convert all EXO-owned executable engineering operations and all first-party UI to Rust over gated phases, retaining the original erythrofr ClothCraft Rust engine as a compatible upstream dependency.

upstream.engines: garment, authoring, fitting, VBD, OGC, CPU solver, feature-gated GPU
upstream.checkoutNote: The local upstream checkout has uncommitted EXO modifications; its HEAD is not proof of the current upstream GitHub tip. Freeze clean upstream and EXO patch inventory before claiming upstream compatibility.

interpretation: Rust percentages are first-party backend source-line ratios by filename classification, NOT converted behavior or a promised percent complete. Upstream-derived Rust reference lines, generated bundles, CSS and UI are counted separately. Rust-native end goal includes egui/wgpu UI and desktop shell; any minimal OS API calls need recorded non-Rust exceptions.

phases.description: Source identity, Rust/EXO adapter, canonical model, typed command transport, crash-safe history. First protect dirty trees and pin upstream.
Source geometry, parametric dependencies, grading, POM, allowances and precise interactive CAD behavior.
Rust seam/constructive sewing and deterministic panel mesh compilation.
Validated solver, contact, avatars, physical fabrics and garment fitting.
Materials, PBR, trims, padding, library assets and 3D export.
Industrial interchange, markers, plotting, tech packs, cost and manufacturing safety.
Agent safety, collaboration, diagnostics, ownership review and workspace commands.
Replace React/Three/WebKit UI with upstream-compatible egui/wgpu desktop after backend parity; keep old UI until full acceptance.

systems.work: Define versioned ExoGarmentV2 with stable piece/edge/size IDs, SI units and serde migrations. Make Rust the only committed mutation owner; map existing C++ and JS documents through adapters without stripping metadata.
systems.acceptance: Open legacy and new projects; change a curve, reload, compare serialized schema and unchanged seam IDs; reject stale or future schema atomically.
systems.name: Project model / source-of-truth

systems.work: Move intersections, ruler construction, snaps, constraints and high-DPI coordinate conversion into a typed Rust geometry API. React pointer interactions become commands, not independent math.
systems.acceptance: Millimetre-golden geometric fixtures at multiple zoom/DPI; invalid/nonfinite inputs reject; traced pointer command equals Rust result and undo works.
systems.name: Drafting primitives and snapping

systems.work: Consolidate Bézier, freehand smoothing, arc length, tangent and offset logic. Remove duplicated JS/C++ results only after Rust exact-coordinate and tolerance parity.
systems.acceptance: Curve closure, tangency, area and sampled lengths match independent numerical oracles; preserve shape and control-point IDs after save/reopen.
systems.name: Curves, freehand and geometry

systems.work: Implement atomic cut, split, merge, mirror and unfold transactions on the canonical Rust panel graph; remap seam links, notches and allowances using stable IDs.
systems.acceptance: Self-intersections and orphan references fail without mutation; reversible mirrored curved panel works across undo/redo and six graded sizes.
systems.name: Topology / split / unfold / mirror

systems.work: Make the Rust parameter dependency DAG authoritative for point formulas, cross-panel references, unit-aware constraints and selective regeneration. Eliminate detached JS recalculation.
systems.acceptance: Cycle and unit-error negative tests; changing an armhole formula deterministically updates sleeve, facing and every graded derivative; cold reopen preserves graph.
systems.name: Parametric references / formulas

systems.work: Integrate Rust WASM/native size transforms into one graded master with named size correspondence, graded Bézier controls, persistent grade rules and activation from real editor controls.
systems.acceptance: Six nonuniform named sizes plus 24-size stress; independent coordinate checks; UI save/undo/redo/reopen; no size-rule drift in CUT/DXF.
systems.name: Pattern grading / size runs

systems.work: Port POM definitions, body-size chart formulas, dimension rulers and chart recomputation into canonical Rust SI-unit records with explicit target references.
systems.acceptance: Compare known POMs on tee/trousers in every size, including curved garment landmarks; invalid units, orphan targets and circular charts fail closed.
systems.name: Measurements / POM / body charts

systems.work: Unify seam endpoint, direction, partial seam, easing and stitch sequencing in Rust. Remove alternate JS/C++ sewing authority only when linked seams survive remesh and grade.
systems.acceptance: Closed/open-zipper fixtures and seam-length tolerance; sew/edit/undo/reopen; report unmatched intervals and invalid sewing instead of covering them visually.
systems.name: Sewing / seam matching

systems.work: Add explicit Rust darts, tuck, pleat, facing and fold construction entities, orientation rules and reversible pattern transfers with derivative links.
systems.acceptance: Dart transfer and curved facing reconstruct after change, split, undo and grading; no silently discarded sewing marks or material groups.
systems.name: Darts / pleats / facings

systems.work: Make Rust seam allowances, corner treatments, cut/stitch offsets, notch/drill placement and fold markers canonical by edge/size ID.
systems.acceptance: No inverted corner or self-overlap; notches remain attached when curved edges change; 100-mm scale export and negative cutter preflight.
systems.name: Allowance / notch / cutline

systems.work: Compile the Rust panel/seam graph into deterministic triangles, UV/grain mapping, material and vertex IDs, remeshing policies and incremental invalidation.
systems.acceptance: Mesh area/normal quality and boundary/seam invariants on tee, pants and jacket; source IDs survive tessellation changes; no orphan sewing endpoints.
systems.name: Cloth mesh / tessellation

systems.work: Consolidate cloth stepping and constraint material parameters behind one Rust solver contract with CPU reference and feature-gated GPU; retain isolated legacy benchmarks until acceptance.
systems.acceptance: Multiple garment classes, long-run energy/strain traces, deterministic CPU controls, CPU/GPU tolerance cases and real executable ABI; no false certified-fit status.
systems.name: Cloth physics and solver

systems.work: Use Rust OGC/BVH broadphase, self/contact and CCD where independently proven. Define collision masks, thickness, skin/body clearances and temporal consistency.
systems.acceptance: Two-frame and long-run cloth/body plus cloth/cloth tests on moving avatars; negative inverted normals and tunnelling; measured penetrations with thresholds.
systems.name: Collision / contact / penetration

systems.work: Move fitting state, staging transforms, panel initialization and drape caches to versioned Rust records; optional Blender scripts remain offline reference tools.
systems.acceptance: Saved garment repositioned and replayed identically, no float-up or ghosted caches; source edit invalidates stage/fit snapshots; multi-pose review.
systems.name: Garment fit / stage / drape

systems.work: Define Rust avatar geometry, landmarks, skeleton/pose sampling, collision proxies and animation transport; retain license provenance and isolate presentation controls.
systems.acceptance: GLB/OBJ import normals/scale, two body sizes, multiple poses and swept collision; never ship private avatar or assume a visible mesh equals collision source.
systems.name: Avatar / pose / animation

systems.work: Canonicalize fabric stiffness, density, bending, friction, warp/weft and thickness in Rust with SI units and per-panel grain alignment. Keep optical controls separate.
systems.acceptance: Fabric measured swatches versus calibrated drape tests; mechanical edits invalidate solver state, optical edits do not; unit conversion roundtrips.
systems.name: Fabric mechanics / materials

systems.work: Port reproducible texture transforms, scan metadata and material asset validation to Rust where measurable; bind Rust material records into wgpu shaders instead of mirroring entire CSS/JS shader code.
systems.acceptance: Golden pixels and color-space/UV scale checks on named PBR swatches; offline renderer and native UI agree on fabric assignment; no visual claim of mechanical calibration.
systems.name: Fabric visuals / textures / PBR

systems.work: Represent buttons, zippers, trims, hardware anchors and size-specific placements as Rust project entities; use upstream geometry/render surfaces for actual attachment.
systems.acceptance: Zipper teeth and fastener position persist through grade, cut and undo; invalid detached anchors fail; renderer and BOM share the same hardware identity.
systems.name: Hardware / fastener / trims

systems.work: Define attached print/embroidery placement geometry, scalable projection anchors and artwork asset hashes as Rust-editable project data; keep texture compositing in Rust/wgpu.
systems.acceptance: Artwork orientation, print repeat and location survive mesh regeneration, grading and save/reopen; no unresolved asset path escapes export bundle.
systems.name: Garment print graphics / embroidery

systems.work: Merge foam/trapunto kernel math into the Rust garment representation; attach padding/loft sections and physical thickness semantics per panel with reversible edits.
systems.acceptance: Padding seam and loft retention in grading, mesh, material and production records; negative zero-thickness/invalid loft controls and visual cross-checks.
systems.name: Foam / padding / trapunto

systems.work: Replace duplicate C++ OBJ/glTF exporters with canonical Rust geometry serializations preserving scale, materials, winding, texture paths and revision metadata.
systems.acceptance: External glTF/OBJ viewers load test meshes; roundtrip metric scale, normal orientation and UV; no stale simulation mesh or missing asset claims.
systems.name: 3D export and scene assets

systems.work: Build deterministic Rust marker/nesting engines for fabric width, grain, size ratios, quantities and defect constraints, with explicit industrial output revision.
systems.acceptance: Marker does not overlap/out-of-bounds; roll, grain and defect cases reject invalid orders; compare independently measured utilization and cutter-ready layout.
systems.name: Marker layout / nesting / yield

systems.work: Use a Rust DXF import/export layer with declared AAMA/ASTM flavor, layers, physical units, annotations and reliable curve approximation. Keep original importer as conformance fixture.
systems.acceptance: Roundtrip in licensed receiving CAD and re-export without measured POM/grade drift; malformed/duplicate entities reject; cutter acceptance remains external.
systems.name: DXF / CAD interop

systems.work: Generate plotted SVG/PDF tiles from one Rust geometry source, including 100-mm X/Y rulers, print boundaries, notch styles and page join marks.
systems.acceptance: Independently measure printed X/Y 100-mm scale, page alignment and all graded pattern dimensions; invalid scale/unit must fail preflight.
systems.name: SVG / PDF / physical plot

systems.work: Move production preflight to fail-closed Rust with exact source revision, size run, seam allowances, POM tolerances, geometric validity and external approval flags.
systems.acceptance: Mutation/stale-hash tests reject altered source and forged factory status; independent technician measured approval required for true manufacturerReady.
systems.name: Factory preflight / measurement QA

systems.work: Package signed/hash-checked factory manifests in Rust with immutable pattern revision, BOM, grade, cut order, materials, labels and audit trail; no JS sole-source ZIP authority.
systems.acceptance: Byte/content checksum verification, cross-file source identity, safe ZIP names, negative altered count/material; cutter signoff required before cuttingAuthorized=true.
systems.name: Production packages / factory orders

systems.work: Model BOM, techpack measurements, construction diagrams and spec sheets in Rust data contracts, with a native Rust page editor eventually replacing React composition.
systems.acceptance: Techpack, grade and BOM share revision, quantities and materials; XLSX/PDF/JSON parity; reopen a document without lost assets or inline controls.
systems.name: Techpacks / BOM / specification

systems.work: Replace JS/C++ cost arithmetic with Rust deterministic fabric yield, trim/labor cost and price revision logic linked to marker and BOM versions.
systems.acceptance: Numerical and currency-rounding fixtures, lot/roll sensitivity and formula undo; no quote from a superseded marker or bill of materials.
systems.name: Cost / pricing / estimates

systems.work: Make one Rust revisioned transaction/event journal authoritative for CAD, grade, sewing, materials and exports; provide safe crash-consistent save/undo/redo and schema migration.
systems.acceptance: Real UI mixed-draft/native history command sends Rust undo/redo; power-failure injection, cold restart, file hash and history recovery; no original project overwritten.
systems.name: Persistence / undo / history / restore

systems.work: Port catalog search/indexing, provenance, license records and reusable template validation into Rust; keep pure media asset listings declarative where appropriate.
systems.acceptance: Deterministic asset catalog, valid relative paths, duplicate-ID rules and backward-compatible template instantiate/grade/reopen; no unlicensed bundled content.
systems.name: Libraries / templates / presets

systems.work: Expose Rust image-to-pattern measured vector intake with perspective/scale calibration; keep optional OCR/ML service as isolated auxiliary with provenance.
systems.acceptance: Reference photo with verified calibration produces a valid Rust source contour; wrong units, untrusted image and orphan marks fail without mutating user pattern.
systems.name: Image digitizing / vision / references

systems.work: Wrap AI-generated drafts/commands through typed Rust capabilities and preview/diff approval; never let model output directly bypass document, factory or license checks.
systems.acceptance: Hostile or malformed agent commands reject; generated sewing proposal requires acceptance; no factory-ready flags or raw file writes from model output.
systems.name: AI assistant / generation / automation

systems.work: Create a versioned typed Rust command/RPC boundary between EXO and marvelous-cloth; migrate Node decision logic and transport through a compatibility shim while pairing Rust binaries to source hashes.
systems.acceptance: Browser/desktop IPC schema tests, credential/origin checks, backpressure, transport errors, native ABI probes, full real edit/save/reopen across subprocess restart.
systems.name: API / processes / transport

systems.work: Move authoritative permissions, optimistic-lock source revisions and collaboration merge validation to Rust; retain any UI presence and rendering in the client.
systems.acceptance: Concurrent edit collision/rollback cases, privilege-denied mutation, stale revision, secure secrets, deterministic merge and authorization negative fixtures.
systems.name: Collaboration / security / sync

systems.work: Expose Rust structured timing, solver/geometry diagnostics, invariants and provenance logs with optional tracing streams. Keep cross-language QA harnesses until conversion evidence closes.
systems.acceptance: Trace links source/size/solver/schema/commit; performance baselines across machines with no hidden green status for failed collision/plot/grade gates.
systems.name: Diagnostics / performance / misc

systems.work: Adopt and extend upstream egui authoring interactions as EXO's Rust-native interface, mapping current 2D/3D and inspector commands to Rust canonical document without duplicating geometry authority.
systems.acceptance: Keyboard/mouse/touch smoke, undo transaction parity, screenshots and accessibility audit; editable tee and hood; no regression in EXO save/reopen or solver state.
systems.name: Native Rust editor / backend UI glue

systems.work: Pin the clean erythrofr upstream commit as an auditable Rust dependency. Separate EXO extensions via adapter crate and explicit feature flags; reconcile dirty local modifications before integration; prepare upstreamable patches individually.
systems.acceptance: Clean upstream Cargo tests + EXO adapter tests; API/serde compatibility, identical units, original upstream editor opens base fixture; no source copying without provenance.
systems.name: Native Rust engine shared core

systems.work: Trace unclassified JS imports and actual runtime calls. Assign every command to a Rust module or mark pure presentation and remove only proven dead duplicates; preserve tests.
systems.acceptance: 100% of 108 classified source files have reviewed ownership ledger, deterministic Rust migration or documented UI-only retention; never delete on filename alone.
systems.name: Unclassified JS business logic

systems.work: Recreate tools, keymaps, property inspectors, customization and command routing in egui Rust; persist user preferences in versioned Rust schema.
systems.acceptance: Input-equivalence tests for select, draw, grade, seam and undo; keyboard shortcut collisions and restored layout/theme after relaunch.
systems.name: Workspace commands / tools / preferences

systems.work: Replace Swift WKWebView shell only after Rust-native eframe/wgpu packaging handles windows, menu, dialogs, file access, GPU startup and safe lifecycle; keep limited native OS FFI when unavoidable.
systems.acceptance: Clean Apple Silicon macOS installer and Windows/Linux smoke, open/save/reopen, cancellation and GPU recovery; codesign/notarization, rollback and bundle/source parity.
systems.name: macOS native host / lifecycle

systems.work: Inventory miscellaneous integration and techpack-studio backends; assign Rust service boundaries or discard only evidence-proven abandoned prototypes.
systems.acceptance: Each remaining file has owner, dependency, test fixture, license classification and native replacement or documented noncritical presentation exception.
systems.name: Other backend source

ui.method: Non-test React UI component JS/JSX/TS and matching CSS from src/App.jsx, src/main.jsx, src/components/**, src/*.css; filename-based primary UI area; CSS listed as UI styles, not Rust; excludes third-party CSS, assets, external Rust/egui UI and code contained in backend paths. Product-feature completion is not measured.

groups.acceptance: Match desktop 2D/3D split, tool access, preferences, file state and reopening; comparison screenshot and keyboard walkthrough.

groups.name: 3D viewport & simulation

groups.acceptance: Camera/picking/parity and stable CPU/GPU frame playback with versioned document, no ghost frame.

groups.acceptance: File-by-file 100% ownership and screenshot/interactions acceptance; no silent deletion.

groups.name: Tech packs & specifications
groups.rustTarget: Native egui techpack page editor driven by Rust BOM/POM/spec document; import visual page objects and responsive grids.
groups.acceptance: Export PDF/XLSX with same engineering content, page rendering and saved edit history.

groups.name: Tools, inspectors & settings
groups.rustTarget: Convert React inspectors, color/theme settings, commands, palettes, custom widgets to typed Rust egui state and persisted preferences.
groups.acceptance: All panel controls, shortcuts, customizations, undo routing and layout restoration tested.

groups.name: CAD drawing & pattern editing
groups.rustTarget: Create Rust 2D canvas using upstream authoring and egui painter with calibrated coordinate space, snapping and selection.
groups.acceptance: DPI/zoom/pointer/snap parity, millimeter ruler, multi-step undo and real sketch-to-pattern smoke.

groups.name: Factory & interchange
groups.rustTarget: Eg ui factory panels, DXF import/export dialogs, size marker controls and clear production safety flags backed by Rust validation.
groups.acceptance: UI cannot authorize invalid CUT; generated DXF/PDF and marker metadata match Rust project.

groups.name: Sewing & construction
groups.rustTarget: Use upstream atelier/seams_ui.rs and seam_links.rs to build native edge binding, stitch direction, sewing status and staged construction panels.
groups.acceptance: Real pointer seam connection, orphan rejection, cold reopen and sewn mesh view consistency.

groups.name: Grading & measurements
groups.rustTarget: Native egui grading table, six-size overlay, formula and POM inspectors bound directly to Rust master size run.
groups.acceptance: Real edit/Save/Undo/Redo on six distinct graded sizes, output coordinate equivalence.

groups.name: Libraries & references
groups.rustTarget: Rust catalog previews, template browser, searchable indexed file library, image import and provenance panel.
groups.acceptance: Source hash/rights displayed; valid file open, missing asset and migration behaviors tested.

groups.name: Fabrics, trims & materials
groups.rustTarget: Native color/fabric browser, physically meaningful material sliders and trim placement via egui/wgpu and Rust material records.
groups.acceptance: Optical-only change does not reset physics; mechanical edit does, with exact texture and visual QA.

groups.name: AI & assistant
groups.rustTarget: Native conversational/agent panel invokes validated Rust tool commands; keep ML services optional isolated integrations.
groups.acceptance: Review/diff before apply, unauthorized proposal rejection and no factory-ready claim from AI output.

globalAcceptance: No repository-wide rewrite in one step: each migration unit is a module or transaction with traced current runtime ownership, source hash and accepted tests.
One shared project source of truth using versioned Rust structs, metres/kilograms/seconds/Newtons internally and explicit mm conversions at manufacturing/export boundaries.
Clean original erythrofr/ClothCraft baseline must build/test without EXO patches; EXO Rust adapters must build against pinned upstream APIs; upstream patch proposals stay separately reviewable.
For each system: golden source fixtures, JS/C++/Python-to-Rust parity where reference is reliable, malformed-input negatives, integrated UI command tests, undo/reopen and migration/recovery checks.
No tested source module automatically qualifies as active installed code; stage exact binary hashes, CPU/GPU feature metadata, new-app installer evidence and rollback.
Production exports need independent external CAD and measured print/cutter evidence; drape/fit needs physical and multi-frame contact acceptance; never infer certification from percentages.

Native UI migration captures feature inventory, interaction contracts, screenshots, keyboard access and persistency; current React desktop remains operational until Rust egui UI passes independent parity.
Every system and UI area gets a tracked owner, upstream compatibility version, acceptance reviewer, positive and negative tests; percent increases require durable proof of source/runtime migration.
